name: The Solène Gown
silhouette: Sweeping Bell Silhouette with Corseted Waist
description: Our house silhouette. Constructed with twelve interior spiral bones, a hand-pleated sweetheart neckline, and four graduating tiers of airy French organza that float weightlessly.
craftDetails: Every layer is trimmed by hand with fine bullion metallic thread. Jaipur zardozi wire embroidery is applied along the hip line, catching candlelight with whisper-quiet subtlety.

name: Amara Column
description: A statue-like column carved to elongate the figure. Features a sculptural high bateau collar and an unexpected slit framed with understated micro-pearl trim.
craftDetails: Cut on the true bias to mold seamlessly against the ribcage and spine without a single pull or buckle.

name: Rosalind Cape Sleeve
description: Dramatically fluid cape sleeves cascade from shoulder to hem, billowing with every step. The inner sheath remains sharply tailored and figure-defining.
craftDetails: The cape edges are finished with invisible blind-stitch hems worked entirely by master tailors in our Jaipur courtyard atelier.

name: Iris Bodice
silhouette: Structured Victorian Bodice with Soft A-Line
description: A contemporary interpretation of traditional corsetry. Features a curved Basque waistline and exposed gold-toned grommet lacing at the rear.
craftDetails: Reinforced with featherlight flexi-boning that provides posture without pinching or restricting breath.

name: Vesna Wrap
silhouette: Surplice Wrap with Fluid Fluted Hem
description: An effortlessly sensuous wrap gown draped directly on the mannequin. Secures with an internal bespoke sash and a handcrafted horn buckle.
craftDetails: Sandwashed to achieve a matte, peach-skin feel against the skin with an organic drape that moves like liquid mercury.

name: Ondine Trail
description: Designed for unforgettable entrances. Hugs the contours before flaring into a magnificent ripple train with hidden wrist loops for dancing.
craftDetails: The train features 24 hours of hand-guided needlework recreating archival botanical motifs in spun gold zari thread.
